codes.evidence_quote: In this multicenter, single-arm, open-label phase 2 clinical trial, the efficacy and safety of L. lac_G01, in combination with avelumab, an anti-PD-L1 inhibitor, were evaluated in 42 PD-L1 positive advanced gastric cancer patients.

codes.evidence_quote: Tropheryma whipplei and Cryptococcus antimicrobial therapies were sequentially administered.

codes.evidence_quote: For this study, all five women received 1 week oral MET treatment after baseline assessment and every subsequent time point for which they tested positive for BV.

codes.evidence_quote: After treatment with empiric antibiotics, his inflammatory parameters decreased without significant relief of abdominal pain.

codes.evidence_quote: Treatment involved oral oseltamivir and fluid replacement for headache/intracranial pressure.

codes.evidence_quote: In ten healthy women undergoing COH for oocyte donation, paired saliva and subgingival plaque samples were collected before stimulation and at peak systemic E2.

codes.evidence_quote: Related study aims to investigate microbiome change and microbial interactions in airway before and following elexacaftor/tezacaftor/ivacaftor (ETI) in adults with CF and advanced lung disease.

codes.evidence_quote: Following antibiotic treatment, the ulcers subsided significantly, but a high fever persisted.

intervention_detail: Antibiotic therapy given clinically to an AIDS patient with Bartonella vinsonii bacillary angiomatosis; plasma sampled for mNGS.
note: Single-patient diagnostic case report.

codes.evidence_quote: Empirical treatment with moxifloxacin and trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole (TMP-SMZ) was initiated.

intervention_detail: Empirical moxifloxacin/TMP-SMZ then TMP-SMZ plus imipenem, later doxycycline, all prescribed clinically; BALF sampled for mNGS.
note: Single-patient diagnostic case report.

codes.evidence_quote: Participants with T2D were patients hospitalized to receive a standardized 2-week intensive glycemic control program at Osaka University Hospital between 2017 and 2019, which was not limited to severely uncontrolled cases.

codes.evidence_quote: Single patient observation A 75-year-old dominant dystrophic EB (DDEB) patient ( COL7A1 , c.6127 G > A) volunteered to participate in an observation study involving topical application of a low-dose calcipotriol ointment.

codes.evidence_quote: The patient recovered rapidly following a change of appropriate antifungal treatment and was discharged.

intervention_detail: Antifungal therapy changed clinically after mNGS of BALF identified Aspergillus fumigatus in an infant with chronic granulomatous disease.

codes.evidence_quote: After targeted treatment for visceral leishmaniasis in the patients, mNGS reported a decrease in the reads number of Leishmania sequence.

codes.evidence_quote: Daignosis of anti-IgLON5 encephalopathy with concomitant herpes virus encephalitis, a case report

codes.evidence_quote: Here we characterize the longitudinal gut virome in 44 recipients of HSCT using metagenomics.

intervention_detail: Allogeneic haematopoietic stem cell transplantation delivered as clinical treatment; stool virome followed longitudinally before and after transplant and related to enteric GVHD.
note: Observational cohort around clinically indicated HSCT. As with the other HSCT projects, 'surgery' is a loose code for a transplant that is an infusion after conditioning.

codes.evidence_quote: FMT settembre 2025
codes.evidence_source: ENA study title and description PRJEB102317

intervention_detail: Faecal microbiota transplantation implied by the study name; 24 human gut metagenomes from Policlinico Hospital Milan, sample aliases in paired T0/T1 form (e.g. TCT0/TCT1, PST0/PST1, MMFT0/MMFT1) and every sample described as 'Human gut metagenome of a patient with UC'.
note: No paper, no protocol text, and a two-word description. The paired T0/T1 aliases and the ulcerative-colitis population make a pre/post FMT administration very likely, but nothing in the record states who gave the FMT, and FMT can also be clinical care that a study merely observed. Needs a human look or author contact.

codes.evidence_quote: Both groups received one large (60-65g) egg, 150 mL of cow’s milk and multiple micronutrients 6 days/week for 3 months, plus an anti-helminthic ( 16 ).

intervention_detail: BEED study interventional phase: one large egg, 150 mL cow's milk, multiple micronutrients 6 days/week for 3 months plus an anti-helminthic, given to all enrolled stunted children; duodenal and faecal samples came from the non-responders who then underwent study endoscopy.
note: Full text states the study has 'an interventional phase designed to test whether a nutritional intervention administered for 3 months would improve linear growth', so the supplement was given by this study, not observed. The anti-helminthic in the same package is a study-given drug (missing code). The endoscopy was performed for research ('we performed endoscopy in 80 children') but no catalog code fits it; 'surgery' would overstate an upper endoscopy.

codes.evidence_quote: The aim of this study was to evaluate the clinical utility of metagenomic next-generation sequencing (mNGS) in sepsis patients receiving early empirical antibiotic treatment.

intervention_detail: Sepsis patients already on early empirical antibiotics; mNGS evaluated as a diagnostic, with no treatment assigned by the study.
note: Catalog links only two reuse preprints, no own-data paper; the archive description is explicit that patients were 'receiving' empirical antibiotics. The reading's own detail line already said 'observed, not study-administered'.

codes.evidence_quote: As part of the yaws eradication campaign, 83% of Lihir Island inhabitants were given a single dose of oral azithromycin (30 mg/kg; max 2g) and were re-examined every six months for up to 48 months.

intervention_detail: Single oral dose of azithromycin 30 mg/kg (max 2 g) mass drug administration to 83% of Lihir Island inhabitants in a yaws eradication trial; ulcer swabs for this metagenomic analysis collected prospectively 36, 42 and 48 months post-MDA, with incident ulcer cases and household contacts also treated with azithromycin.
note: Borderline. The azithromycin was given by the parent yaws-eradication campaign (which the authors call 'the trial') rather than by the sequencing analysis, but the sampled participants were treated inside that protocol and specimens were collected prospectively for microbiome analysis, so this is not ordinary observed clinical care. All sequenced specimens are post-MDA; there is no pre-treatment arm.

codes.evidence_quote: We performed a pilot observational study, obtained retroauricular and forearm skin swabs from 12 adult patients before conditioning chemotherapy/radiation and at 1 week, 1 month, and 3 months after allogeneic HSCT, and performed shotgun metagenomic sequencing.

We performed a pilot observational study, obtained retroauricular and forearm skin swabs from 12 adult patients before conditioning chemotherapy/radiation and at 1 week, 1 month, and 3 months after allogeneic HSCT, and performed shotgun metagenomic sequencing.

intervention_detail: Conditioning chemotherapy/radiation and allogeneic HSCT delivered as clinical treatment to 12 adults; skin swabs taken before conditioning and at 1 week, 1 month and 3 months after transplant.
note: The paper calls itself a pilot observational study. As elsewhere, 'surgery' is a loose code for HSCT.

codes.evidence_quote: In this study, 16 consecutive patients from January 2020 to January 2021 at the Second Affiliated Hospital of Zhejiang University School of Medicine (SAHZU) were reviewed.

intervention_detail: Cholesteatoma removal performed as clinical ear surgery in 16 consecutive patients; the excised tissue was used for metagenomic sequencing.
note: Retrospective review of consecutive surgical patients; the operation was indicated treatment and the specimens were a by-product.

codes.evidence_quote: Despite the global use of rotavirus vaccines, vaccine breakthrough cases remain a pediatric health problem.

intervention_detail: Infants who had already completed the two-dose Rotarix schedule through routine immunisation and then presented with gastroenteritis; stool investigated for breakthrough infection and coinfections.
note: The vaccine was given by the national immunisation programme before enrolment; the study investigated suspected breakthrough cases and administered nothing.

codes.evidence_quote: We aimed to explore the effects of broad-spectrum combination antibiotic therapy on Pseudomonas aeruginosa populations in the lungs of cystic fibrosis patients.

intervention_detail: Broad-spectrum combination antibiotic therapy for cystic fibrosis exacerbation, with daily sputum sampling to track Pseudomonas aeruginosa populations at high temporal resolution.
note: Provisional: no linked paper in the catalog and no match found in Europe PMC, so this rests on the two-sentence archive description. That description says the study explored the effects of therapy the patients were receiving and does not state that the regimen was assigned; CF exacerbation antibiotics are normally clinical care. Dense daily sampling is a research protocol, but sampling is not an intervention.

codes.evidence_quote: Using a multi-omics approach on resected aspergillomas, we defined the genomic, transcriptional, and metabolic adaptations of P. aeruginosa within this polymicrobial niche.

intervention_detail: Pulmonary lobectomy/resection performed as clinical treatment of chronic pulmonary aspergillosis; 61 resected fungal balls were analysed by multi-omics.
note: Specimens are surgical waste from therapeutic resections; the study did not perform the operations for research.

codes.evidence_quote: Zirconia implants were used to treat ten patients who received vascularized bone flaps used for jaw reconstruction (six fibula and four DCIA flaps).

intervention_detail: Zirconia dental implants placed in fibula free flaps and deep circumflex iliac artery flaps in ten reconstructed jaws; peri-implant microbiota sampled immediately after implant surgery and at 3 and 12 months.
note: The companion clinical paper (PMID 39694985) describes a prospective 1.5-year follow-up of these implants, which reads like a prospective evaluation of a device the investigators placed, but neither record says whether the implant type was chosen for the study or as ordinary prosthetic rehabilitation. The implants were clinically needed either way; only the 'for research' part is unresolved.

codes.evidence_quote: Using instrumented spine surgery as a model of clean (class I) skin incision, we prospectively sampled preoperative microbiomes and postoperative SSI isolates in a cohort of 204 patients.

intervention_detail: Instrumented spine surgery performed for clinical indications in 204 patients, with preoperative microbiome sampling and postoperative wound isolates collected prospectively; surgical antibiotic prophylaxis was standard perioperative care.
note: Prospective observational cohort. The prophylactic antibiotic mentioned in the abstract is routine perioperative care, so it is not a missing administered code.

codes.evidence_quote: In this retrospective study, we enrolled 51 LTx recipients who underwent lung transplantation between January 2020 and December 2020.

intervention_detail: Lung transplantation performed as clinical treatment for end-stage lung disease; BALF collected post-transplant by bronchoscopy and tested by high-throughput sequencing for pathogens.
note: Explicitly retrospective; the transplant and the bronchoscopies were clinical care.

codes.evidence_quote: 161 subjects from low exposure villages and 74 subjects from medium exposure village were recruited in 2016, after all villages received Ivermectin treatment (see Table S5 for details).
codes.evidence_source: ENA study description PRJEB55648 (second clause of a run-on sentence, trimmed to stay under the 40-word cap)

intervention_detail: Amerindian villagers sampled in 2015 before and in 2016 after an ivermectin mass-treatment programme reached their villages; one village additionally had a medical post supplying medicines, antibiotics, antiparasitics and vaccines.
note: The ivermectin was a public-health programme the study sampled around, not an administration by the study; the wording 'started' and 'received' places the campaign outside the study. No paper matched in Europe PMC. If this were ever recoded as administered, drug_therapy would fit the agent better than other_intervention.

codes.evidence_quote: To analyze the etiology and drug resistance of pulmonary infection after cardiac surgery

intervention_detail: Cardiac surgery performed for clinical indications; patients who developed fever afterwards were investigated for pulmonary infection and antimicrobial resistance genes.
note: Provisional: no linked paper and no Europe PMC match, so this rests on a single-sentence archive description. Nothing suggests the operations were done for research.
